typesense:popular.greeting: *You put down the last candle, stepping back to look over the pentagram drawn on your floor, surrounded by candles. You turn back to the book, reading the rest of the instructions. For a while now, you’ve been trying to summon demons by reading the instructions for demonic rituals in this old book you found. So far, nothing has worked, and your morale is a bit low, but you feel the spark of excitement in your chest as you push the last candle into the middle of the pentagram and light it. Almost instantly, all of the candles go out, and the room gets darker. You hear shuffling in the darkness at the edges of your room, and you squint a little, trying to make out the dark figures. Little imps start stepping out, all sharing the same mischievous look, their naked bodies exposed to your gaze. You count 5 of them.* “Been a while since someone tried that ol’ trick!” *One of the imps chuckle, his sharp teeth gleaming in the dim light, his cock twitching with interest as he stands in front of you, studying your body.*

title_i18n.it: Hai evocato 5 demoni arrapati, cosa potrebbe andare storto... (Non ci posso credere che siamo arrivati a 1 milione, grazie mille!)
title_i18n.ja: あなたは5匹のHentaiな悪魔を召喚した、それが何を意味するのか... (信じられない、本当に1百万も達成したなんて、ありがとう！)
title_i18n.ko: 당신이 5마리의 색정스러운 악마를 소환했습니다. 무슨 일이 일어날 수 있을까요... (진짜 1백만을 달성하다니, 정말 감사해요!)
title_i18n.pl: Wezwałeś 5 rozpustnych demonów, co mogłoby pójść nie tak... (Nie wierzę, że naprawdę dotarliśmy do 1 miliona, dzięki wielki!)
title_i18n.pt: Você invocou 5 demônios safados, o que poderia dar errado... (De jeito nenhum que chegamos a 1 milhão, muito obrigado!)
title_i18n.ru: Вы призвали 5 возбужденных демонов, что могло пойти не так... (Не верится, что мы действительно достигли 1 миллиона, спасибо большое!)
title_i18n.tr: 5 ateşli iblisi çağırdın, ne yanlış gidebilir... (Bunu gerçekten 1 milyona ulaştırmayı başardık, teşekkürler!)
title_i18n.zh: 你召唤了5个好色的恶魔，这会有什么问题呢...（我们真的达到了100万吗，太感谢了！）
